# OtpInput
Atlas OTP Input — a one-time or verification code, one slot per digit. Size × State × Length (75 total).

USE WHEN
· Entering a one-time or verification code sent by email, SMS or an authenticator.
· A fixed-length numeric code of 4 to 8 digits.
DON'T USE WHEN
· Free text or a password → Input or Password input.
· A code longer than 8 characters, or one that mixes letters → Input.
HOW TO USE
· Drawn as one slot per digit; in code it is one real input (inputMode numeric, autoComplete one-time-code), so paste and autofill work.
· Length is a value from 4 to 8 (default 6). Size matches Input: sm, md, lg.
· Wrap in a Field for the label and error text. Error shows the danger border on every slot.
DO
· Say where the code was sent and offer a resend.
DON'T
· Block paste, or split the code into separate form fields.
RELATED
· Input — one free-text line; OTP Input is a fixed-length numeric code.
· Field — wraps OTP Input with a label, help text and error.
